title: The Dweller Pack
description: This project adds many dweller horror mods and a few shaders.
body: This modpack is made for Forge 1.19.2 and it adds many popular horror dweller mods such as the Mimicer, the Boiled One, the Cave Dweller, The Man From the Fog and From the Fog (this one isn't really terrifying, by the way). It also adds libraries and dependencies such as Architectury API and GeckoLib. Shaders are also included in this modpack. If you want a good horror pack with dwellers and shaders that will make the game bright (or spooky), this modpack is for you! (That is, if you play on Forge 1.19.2)
